items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Mr. Falk here, this man I was telling you about, that my grandfather worked, made it possible for his—the two of them to buy a home.

ctx.x: That got the same house over there? Yes, the same house, yes.

Because my grandmother started moving around later on. After different members of the family would die, she would move out of the houses. Mm-hmm. And people did a lot of renting houses then. Yeah. But I know from the—from 1925, I think, or 30, they moved in their own home. Because Mr. Falk here, this man I was telling you about, that my grandfather worked, made it possible for his—the two of them to buy a home. That's—that's the home that they have now on St. Anthony Street. So, when I got married, I moved just…
In those days, nobody was born in hospital. Oh, no. Right at home.
